assessments.remediation: The replacement image retains only libuuid from util-linux 2.42.3-r1. Alpine secfixes explicitly records these fixes at or below this version.
assessments.residual_risk: Vendor fix evidence applies to these CVEs, not a claim of general nonexploitability. BusyBox mount/login/nsenter are distinct implementations.

assessments.remediation: The advisory concerns login -h. The new image uses BusyBox login; only libuuid remains from util-linux, whose upstream 2.42 includes the fix.
assessments.residual_risk: Source package association is broader than the vulnerable executable. No exploit was attempted.

assessments.remediation: Alpine ncurses 6.6_p20260516 is newer than the upstream fixes 6.5-20251213 (infocmp) and 6.5-20250329 (termcap parser). infocmp is absent in the new app image.
assessments.residual_risk: Version-range evidence supports resolving these findings; no exploitability or security certification claim.

assessments.remediation: Alpine secfixes explicitly records the CRC32 combine fix in zlib 1.3.2-r0.
assessments.residual_risk: Other zlib advisories, particularly CVE-2026-85091, remain separate concerns.

assessments.remediation: UNRESOLVED: new zlib 1.3.2 is within the published affected range. Alpine secfixes/APKBUILD has no corresponding patch; await a supported vendor fix despite an empty Trivy result.
assessments.residual_risk: Carried forward at supplied MEDIUM severity. Non-blocking gzwrite followed by gzprintf/gzvprintf with a stale buffer is required; reachability through Python/application code is unproven, not ruled out.
